aggregation_units.head_metrics: per-example loss, aggregated to the same CE-ratio / top-1 / Brier statistics the accepted artifact reports

bootstrap.head_metrics: CLUSTER bootstrap resampling GAMES, not examples: examples inside one game are correlated, and an example-level bootstrap would understate the interval
bootstrap.play_metrics: paired bootstrap over setup pairs, matching the accepted Phase 8 protocol
bootstrap.seeds: validation_bootstrap_seed 2026081306 for validation, test_bootstrap_seed 2026081307 for the sealed test

new_control_comparison.design: paired non-inferiority of the NEW control against the ACCEPTED checkpoint, predeclared before the new control result is opened

known_fragility_flagged_before_the_run.counterpart: the vs-init gate is robust: the accepted 0.9170 clears its 0.70 gate by 25.2 SE
known_fragility_flagged_before_the_run.fact: the accepted result 0.956787 clears its own 0.95 gate by 0.006787 EWR, which is 1.511 binomial SE at n=2048
known_fragility_flagged_before_the_run.implication: a faithful reproduction that is genuinely equal in strength still fails this point-estimate gate about 6.5% of the time
known_fragility_flagged_before_the_run.predeclared_interpretation: if the control fails ONLY this gate while (a) its paired bootstrap lower bound still exceeds 0.90, and (b) its paired delta against the accepted checkpoint satisfies vs_random_ewr_delta_min, the packet records a REPRODUCTION TOLERANCE EVENT, sets G1 to REVISE, and escalates to the operator. It is NOT recorded as a pass. This interpretation is fixed here, before any control result exists, and may not be widened afterwards.

mps_nondeterminism_handling.fact: MPS is not bitwise reproducible run to run; Phase 17 measured a 9.83e-07 spread between two identical runs, and 25,000 updates amplify it
mps_nondeterminism_handling.if_the_control_lands_outside_margin: run ONE replicate control under the same frozen config to estimate run-to-run spread before concluding the reproduction failed; a single out-of-margin control with no replicate does not distinguish an implementation defect from MPS variance
mps_nondeterminism_handling.logical_resume_rule: resume identity is checked by config and data identity, never by comparing weight digests across a resume; no stop or acceptance predicate may compare weight digests produced on either side of a restart
mps_nondeterminism_handling.rule: the control's weight bytes need not match the accepted checkpoint and a byte comparison is not a gate
what_must_still_match_exactly: canonical fresh init state checksum before the first update
the example order produced by train_shuffle_seed 2026081303
the update count and the validation cadence
the set of checkpoint steps offered to selection

paired_cases_and_seeds.head_metrics: the 4,000-game sealed Phase 8 test split, every selected decision; both models score the SAME example ids in the SAME order; pairing is per example
paired_cases_and_seeds.seed_rule: every seed derives from the frozen Phase 8 seed functions; no new seed namespace is introduced by the control
paired_cases_and_seeds.vs_init: >=512 paired setup cases, >=1,024 games against the canonical untrained C1 built from seed 2026081302; identical cases and seeds for both models
paired_cases_and_seeds.vs_random: evaluation_setup_bank_v1, 1,024 setup pairs x 2 colors = 2,048 games, digest 5fe5f987...674266; identical pair ids and identical per-game seeds for both models

practical_non_inferiority_margins_select.basis: no replicate Phase 8 run exists, so these are predeclared judgments, not estimates from a measured run-to-run distribution; each is stated as an absolute allowance on the paired delta and each is small relative to the original gate headroom
practical_non_inferiority_margins_select.decision_rule: non-inferiority holds when the 95% bootstrap bound on the paired delta lies on the non-inferior side of the margin; a point estimate alone never decides
practical_non_inferiority_margins_select.headroom_note: belief_ce_ratio has the least headroom of the three head gates (accepted 0.9205 against a 0.98 maximum), which is why its margin is half the others'

original_42_gates_applicability_to_the_c.rule: all 42 apply unchanged to the reproduction control; the common contract's replacement of `no_learned_setup_selection` applies ONLY to the later setup-integrated model, never to this control

purpose: Everything an independent agent needs to launch and judge the Phase 8 control without choosing a new field.
ready_for_phase8_control_basis: every frozen identity recomputes, the fresh initialization reconstructs bit-exactly from its seed, the corpus verifies at payload level, the exact constructor call is recorded, and the comparison design, bootstrap, margins and failure interpretations are fixed above before any control result exists.
